people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

translations.web: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.
translations.bsb: And he placed the rest of the troops under the command of his brother Abishai, who arrayed them against the Ammonites.
translations.kjv: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.
translations.asv: And the rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.
